entities.name: Caves of the Damned
entities.description: A colony of Untouchables below Halcyon in the Time of the Thran, once a penal colony, later renamed Koilos by Urza.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: Thran facility whose workers contracted Phthisis from powerstones.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Transported infected to the caves and ushered the last survivors into the portal.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Arranged several escapes through secret passages.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: Planeswalker who built a permanent portal to Phyrexia in the caves.

entities.name: Thran Civil War
entities.description: War at whose end Yawgmoth ushered survivors into the portal.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Rediscovered the caves and named them Koilos.

events.summary: Prisoners in the penal colony overthrow their counselors and take over the caves; Halcyon's guard fails to reclaim them and the city seals off all but one entry.
events.quote: They banded together, overthrew their counselors and facilitators, and took over the caves.

events.summary: Yawgmoth transports more infected from Halcyon to the caves while Gix arranges escapes.
events.quote: Gix arranged for several escapes through secret passages

events.summary: Dyfed builds a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia in the caves.
events.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed built a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia

events.summary: At the end of the Thran Civil War Yawgmoth ushers the last survivors into the portal to populate Phyrexia.
events.quote: Yawgmoth ushered the last survivors into the portal to populate Phyrexia

events.summary: After 5,000 years Urza, Mishra and Tocasia rediscover the caves, and Urza renames them Koilos.
events.quote: They then received the new name " Koilos " from Urza.

relations.note: built a portal inside the caves
relations.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed built a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia
